question: Whose autobiography is titled 'An Unsuitable Boy'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karan Johar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karan Johar** is the author of the autobiography titled 'An Unsuitable Boy'.
 
• Karan Johar is a well-known Indian film director, producer, screenwriter, costume designer, actor, and television personality.
 
• The autobiography provides insights into his personal and professional life, including his experiences in the Bollywood film industry.
 
• It discusses his journey of self-discovery, the challenges he faced, and his views on various aspects of his life and career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karan Johar** made his directorial debut with the blockbuster movie **'Kuch Kuch Hota Hai'** in 1998.
 
• He is the son of the famous Indian film producer **Yash Johar**.
 
• Besides directing and producing films, Karan Johar is also known for hosting the popular talk show **'Koffee with Karan'**.
 
• He has received numerous awards for his contributions to the Indian film industry.
